label.0000025W: Productive forest land without harvesting restrictions, hectare
label.0000025X: Low or none productive forest land, hectare
label.00000267: Productive forest land with harvesting restrictions, hectare

0000025S: At the assessment for agriculture and forestry the land area of each property is separated in the following types of land: productive forest land without harvesting restrictions, non-productive forest land, productive forest land with harvesting restrictions, arable land, cultivated pastures and other area. The sum of areas is the total area of the unit. Productive forest land without harvesting restrictions is land suitable for production of wood at least one cubic meter per hectare and year. Non-productive forest land is land with forest but not able for production of wood at least one cubic meter per hectare and year. Productive forest land with harvesting restrictions are productive forest areas covered by nature conservation or biotope protection. Arable land is land used for or suitable for use for cultivation and suitable for ploughing. Cultivated pastures is land used for or suitable for use as pasture and not suitable for ploughing. Other land is sites, roads, land for power lines etc.
